title: The wilderness above the valley
text: Owens Peak Wilderness, in the mountains west of the Indian Wells Valley, was designated by the California Desert Protection Act of 1994. It is a transition zone between the Great Basin, Mojave Desert, and Sierra Nevada ecoregions. Its canyons hold springs with extensive riparian vegetation, with cottonwood and oak trees in the canyons and valleys. The Pacific Crest Trail passes through the wilderness along the crest and western side.
